text.content:
The bride the whole country fell in love with, in a week.

Role: Celebrity
Affiliation: Sponsored by Continental Brands; the Static Night crew
Known for: The 2047 broadcast wedding to Luigi Falcone; the cult of Roxanne

A week before her wedding in September 2047, nobody had heard of her. Then the Static Night bomber hijacked every broadcast in Night City, aired every secret she and Luigi Falcone had tried to keep, and ordered them to marry within a week or the city would get another Moon rock. Minutes later she was a symbol, and the wedding became the most-watched broadcast in the continent's history.

At the vows the stage blew apart. Out of the smoke a Roxanne erupted onto the wreckage in a whole new look, begged the country to stay calm, and by noon had a movement: the cult of Roxanne. Thousands of her fans wore free prototype Neuroports, and through them something puppeted the crowds that flooded Upper Marina toward Ziggurat's main server terminal.

That Roxanne wasn't the bride. The real Roxanne Lawrence spent the next two days in the dark with the crew that ended Static Night, crossing the city with a sword, a cop and a groom. Continental Brands has backed a Roxanne Lawrence ever since: sponsorships, appearances, security and a foundation in her name.

GM secrets

The woman on the stage gave herself up to be overwritten and rebuilt as Roxanne: face, voice, body, maybe memories. Nobody knows who she was before. Every trail ends at a clinic that doesn't exist and a payment that cleared through three companies. Whether she read the AI's words or it read hers, nobody knows. Which Roxanne Continental backs, Lyle Thompson can't say.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.02, 05
